observations: body L1-L5: the head is set in capitals and small capitals; the dash after «a)» measures 10.1 pt. Appendix F is p. 149 of the translation. The places cited are p. 133 of the translation and p. 317, on planets with latitude, and the commentary on chapter LV, pp. 313-317; «313-17» has a hyphen (3.6 pt). The hyphen of «con-» measures 2.3 pt.

body L6-L15: the title of appendix F is p. 149, L5-L7 of the translation («et scias hanc esse directionem quam Ptolemaeus in profectione hilegii explicat»). The Arabic is set as printed, with its vowel signs: تسيّر with the shadda (L7), تسيُّر with damma and shadda (L11, L12), تُسَيَّر, تَسِير and تُسَيِّر; the hamza of انتهاء (L10) prints as a dot. In the Arabic text, vol. III, p. 224, the line after the title of the chapter (L11 by the count of that page) reads «في تسيُّر الهيلاج», and L14 has تسير twice, as Nallino says. The places of the version are p. 149, L15 («a quo directionem incipere statuisti») and L16 («ad quem directionem pervenire iubes»), as printed. The hyphens of «Ptole-», «di-» and «directio-» measure 2.5, 2.3 and 2.5 pt; the dash before «In sequentibus» (L12) measures 10.1 pt; «al–‘ulūm» (L11) has a long dash (5.4 pt).

body L16-L23: «Ptolemaeus» is letter-spaced. The year 363 of the hijrah began on 1 October 973 and the year 381 ended on 7 March 992 (tabular calendar, astronomical epoch); «363-381» has a hyphen (3.6 pt), «973–991» a long dash (about 5.5 pt, joined to the figures). The dash of «al–‘ulūm» (L19) measures 5.5 pt. The hyphen of «ascen-» measures 2.8 pt.

body L24-L30: «Kūshiyār ibn Labbān» and «Sachau» are letter-spaced. The dash after «deest.» measures 10.2 pt, that before «Itaque» (L30) 10.1 pt; the dashes of «az–zīǵ» and «al–istiwā’» measure 5.5 pt each; «163–64» has a long dash (about 5.5 pt). The commentary of pp. 163-164 is on al-Battānī's tables of right ascensions counted from the beginning of Capricorn; Nallino's addenda (Part I, p. LXXII) refer back to this place for Kūshiyār's table, as recorded on p. 164. The Arabic مطالع البروج بالجويراست runs from the end of L27 to the head of L28. The hyphen of «tabu-» measures 3.0 pt.

notes_left L1-L8: the Arabic is set as printed: the corrupt reading الحواراسب and the archetype الجوى راست with the alif maqṣūrah; the alif of L8 prints as a slanting stroke. The dash before «Codicis» (L4) measures 9.5 pt. «vo» (L5) is printed without the hyphen of the division «vo-cabulum».
notes_left L9-L12: «‘Alī ibn Riḍwān» is letter-spaced; the hyphen of «Vene-» prints as a dot, those of «Pla-» and «editori-» measure 1.9 and 2.2 pt.

notes_right L1-L11: the end of note 2 begun in the left column. The hyphens of «Commenta-» and «Tebal-» print as dots. «Abù ‘Abdallàh Mohammed ibn Ahmed al-Khowàrezmì», «Ahlwardt» and «Suter» are letter-spaced; the title of note 3 is set as printed, with the circumflex of «Mafâtih», the accent over the u of «‘olûm» printing as a dot, and with the grave accents of the author's name; «al–‘olûm» has a dash of 4.7 pt, «al-Kho-» a hyphen (3.4 pt). «1887-99» and «83-84» have hyphens (3.4 pt each); the dash after «206,a.» measures 8.6 pt.
